Work in /opt/nxeon. Fix the DOMAIN/REGISTRAR surface. Read `docs/QA-PRELAUNCH.md` (the P1 "furniture" section and any domain findings) and `docs/AUDIT-24H.md` for context; do not edit them.

YOU OWN EXACTLY: `lib/registrar.ts`, `lib/domain-transfer.ts`, `lib/actions-domains.ts` (or whatever the domain server actions file is — find it), `components/customer/Domains*.tsx`, `app/dashboard/domains/**`, and the admin domain-settings component. Nothing else — eight agents run concurrently. `prisma/schema.prisma` is FROZEN (report any field you need). Do NOT touch `worker/billing.ts`, `lib/order.ts`, `lib/settings.ts`, `lib/stripe*`, `docs/**`.

FIX, in priority order:

**1. MONEY BUG — the domain markup displays 0% while customers are charged 25%.** The audit flags an admin markup setting written to the DB and read by nothing, while a different (hardcoded) markup is actually applied at purchase. Find both, make ONE value the source of truth, and make the admin panel display and control what is genuinely charged. A customer-facing price must never be computed by different code than the charge.

**2. Registrar furniture — settings that save and are read by nothing.** The audits name **WHOIS privacy**, **custom nameservers** and **registrar lock** as persisted, confirmed with a green "Saved", and consumed by no code. Each one tells a customer a guarantee is in force when it is not — WHOIS privacy especially, since a customer believing their address is hidden when it is public is a real-world harm, not a cosmetic bug.
For EACH: either wire it through to the registrar API properly, or — if the registrar integration genuinely cannot do it — make the UI say so honestly (disabled with a clear reason) rather than accepting a value it will ignore. Do not leave a third state where it silently pretends.

**3. Anything else in your files that saves and is unread.** Grep for settings/preferences written by an action and never read back. Apply the same rule: wire it or tell the truth.

REQUIREMENTS
- The registrar is Namecheap (`lib/registrar.ts`). Read it before assuming what it supports. READ-ONLY API probing is fine; NEVER register, transfer, renew or modify a real domain.
- Match the Nxeon dark theme; reuse existing classes/components. No new visual styles.
- Every mutating action must check ownership.
- Comment style: explain WHY, cite the real failure prevented.

HARD CONSTRAINTS
- Do NOT run `npm run build`/`npm run dev`, do NOT restart any systemd service (production is live).
- Verify ONLY with `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "test/.*test.ts"` — must be clean for your files.
- Do NOT git commit/push, do NOT edit prisma/schema.prisma, do NOT write to the live database.

Report: what the markup actually was vs displayed and how you unified it, and for each furniture setting whether you wired it or made it honest.
